title: Spec-Driven Development: Write the Spec First, Let AI Build It
summary: Spec driven development AI coding guide: write the spec first, eliminate guessing, and ship clean code with Claude Code or Cursor.
body_markdown: Two common causes: the spec had an ambiguous requirement the agent resolved with a guess (add that constraint explicitly for next time), or the agent's context window got overloaded mid-implementation and it started losing track of later constraints. The fix for the second is to work task by task with smaller sessions, not one massive implementation run.
